title: Responder Relay: Compact Incident Beacon & SLO Cost Preview
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Goal: Design a compact, low-noise on-call artifact — the Responder Relay Beacon — that surfaces the minimal context a responder needs to act quickly while simultaneously showing the incremental SLO impact and a high-level cost delta for mitigations. The component should live in the Console incident strip and be tappable/expandable in Slack/Email handoffs.

Scope and constraints: Compact single-line card with micro-interactions: 1) short incident summary (1 line), 2) top SLO deltas (two metrics max), 3) suggested immediate actions with expected cost delta (+/-), 4) primary postmortem link and one-click create-runbook CTA. Must work across small widths (sidebar and mobile). Must not duplicate full incident timeline. Must be keyboard navigable and screen reader friendly.

User flows covered: initial pager, shift handover, automated runbook suggestion, rollback/rollforward guidance tied to rollout status. The Beacon should offer two depth levels: collapsed (single-row) and expanded (three-row mini-sheet) with inline controls for A/B rollouts and quick model/service fallback.

Design decisions and trade-offs: 1) We display only two SLO deltas to reduce cognitive load; larger deltas are highlighted with color token. Trade-off: losing some signal for complex incidents; mitigated by expansion view. 2) Cost deltas are shown as a range and percentile to avoid false precision. Trade-off: less granular than billing dashboard; mitigated by linking to per-route cost breakdown. 3) Inline action buttons are primary/destructive pattern-aware (confirm modals for rollbacks). 4) We prioritize visibility for the on-call primary and secondary; ephemeral responders see a collapsed-only view.

Accessibility notes: all hues meet AA contrast for text and badges, iconography uses aria-hidden where appropriate, expanded view uses role=dialog with focus trap, and live regions announce SLO changes for assistive tech. Localization: string tokens allow for directionality; cost units respect tenant locale.

Prototypes and assets: Figma file with compact and expanded states, interactive prototype for keyboard/voice simulation, animation specs for height transitions.

Acceptance criteria: - Collapsed Beacon renders at <= 48px height in sidebar. - Expanded mini-sheet follows Console spacing tokens and includes: incident id, 2 SLO deltas, cost delta with link, 1 click-to-create runbook, 1 postmortem link. - Keyboard + screen reader pass. - Product sign-off on data model with Eng.

Next steps: final review with Eng and PM, handoff package, QA checklist, and implementation spike to measure perf impact of inline cost calls.
